title: Chat
summary: The themed chat: level badges, name cards, emotes, stickers, pictures, showcase tokens, whispers, mentions and chat settings.

s.x: SkyRPG restyles chat. Every message shows the sender's level and a hover card, you can show off your gear in a message, and you can post stickers and pictures that appear right in the chat window. It also removes the "Not Secure" marks and report buttons from player chat. This page covers everything you can type and see.
